title: Get Shorty
description: A film-loving loan shark (John Travolta) teams with a B-movie producer (Gene Hackman) to become a Hollywood mogul.

title: Blow Out
description: A sound man (John Travolta) re-creates a political murder-by-car-crash with a sight-and-sound montage.

title: Be Cool
description: Chili Palmer (John Travolta) runs afoul of music-industry players when he teams up with a friend's widow (Uma Thurman) to produce a singer's debut album.
